shared_elements: curvilinear low-relief carving on a rounded stone surface
ring/circle motif enclosing a smaller disc or boss
paired symmetrical curved elements (crescent or eye/ear-like loops)
schematic face-like or masked motif built from arcs
raised outline relief with plain infill
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief carvings built from bold curvilinear outlines: paired symmetrical arcs framing a central boss in A, and on B's back a comparable pair of curved elements above a prominent ring-with-central-disc, plus similar arcing bands, suggesting the same conventional vocabulary of loops, rings and crescents rendered as raised outlines with plain infill. The clearest difference is that B is a full anthropomorphic figure with a carved head and torso on which the motifs are distributed as body decoration, while A shows only an isolated mask-like motif with no accompanying body or figural framework.
